title: Greenlight client listing
description: One entry in the Greenlight client gallery. A listing describes somebody's app; it is not a claim about that app's code. additionalProperties is false throughout, so a typo is a failed check rather than a field that silently does nothing.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, so editors offer completion.

slug.description: URL segment for this listing. Must equal the directory name. Permanent once merged: it is the gallery URL, so changing it breaks links.

tagline.description: One line, shown on the card under the name. Say what it does, not how good it is.

description.description: A paragraph for the listing page.

url.description: Homepage, profile, or wherever you would rather people found you.

repository.description: Where the source lives. Checked for existence, never for quality or safety.

download.description: A release or installer, if there is one. Source-only listings are fine.

license.description: SPDX identifier for the app's own source, e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-or-later. Use NOASSERTION only if the repository genuinely has no licence — expect that to be questioned.

platforms.description: Where the client itself runs. Greenlight's local API is a Windows named pipe today, so windows is the usual answer; the field exists because that is a property of the host, not of this format.

language.description: Primary language, for people filtering by what they would enjoy reading.

integration.description: sdk: built on MeddlingIdiot.Greenlight.Sdk. protocol: speaks the named pipe directly, which is what a non-.NET client does.

greenlight-api.description: The local-API protocol version this client targets. Impossible to retrofit: without it, the day the protocol moves to 2 there is no way to tell which listings still work without asking every author.

build-time.description: Roughly what it took. Optional, and deliberately a fixed set rather than free text — it is an invitation to build one, not a place for marketing copy.

poster.description: Still image beside this file, at most 1 MB. The card's poster frame, and what shows when the clip has not loaded.

clip.description: Optional silent mp4 beside this file: at most 3 MB and under 15 seconds. Cards autoplay it muted and looping.

attestation.description: Impossible to retrofit, and the one field with legal weight. original: you made these, or they are screenshots of your own app. licensed: you have the right to publish them, and attestation-note says where they came from.

attestation-note.description: Required when attestation is licensed: the source and the licence.

last-verified.description: What this listing was last seen working against. Impossible to retrofit, and what keeps the gallery from quietly filling with entries that stopped working two releases ago.

greenlight.description: The Greenlight version it was run against.

sdk.description: The SDK package version, when integration is sdk.

maintained.description: Set false, by you or by the weekly rot pass, when the repository is archived or the client no longer works. The listing stays; the card says so.
